desc:
PrestaShop conversion rate improvements help more of your existing visitors become buyers. Ecom Swift LLC reviews your product pages, cart and checkout as a shopper would, then fixes the points where people hesitate or leave.

## Why do PrestaShop visitors leave without buying?

Most visitors leave a PrestaShop store because a question went unanswered at the moment they needed an answer. They could not see the delivery cost, they doubted the return terms, the cart asked for too much, or the checkout looked unfamiliar at the point of paying. Each gap is small, but a shopper only needs one reason to close the tab.

Traffic does not fix this. Sending more visitors to a store with the same gaps simply repeats the same losses at a higher cost.

## How conversion work lifts revenue

Conversion work increases revenue by making the buying path shorter and more reassuring. A shopper moves through a product page, the cart and the checkout, and each step either builds confidence or erodes it. When the price and the add to cart button are clear, delivery and returns sit next to the price, and the checkout asks only for what is needed, fewer people stop halfway.

Tracking is the other half. Without cart and checkout tracking you cannot tell which step loses people, so every change is a guess. With it, you see where shoppers drop out and can judge whether a change helped. Results still depend on your products, your prices, your traffic and your market, so we describe the work as improving the path, never as a promise of a number.

## What strong PrestaShop conversion work includes

- A product page where price, stock status and the add to cart button sit together above the fold on mobile.
- Delivery times, shipping costs and return terms shown beside the price, not buried in a policy page.
- Trust signals such as payment icons, secure checkout notes and contact details placed near the pay button.
- A cart page that shows the order clearly, allows quantity changes and removes distractions.
- A progress bar toward free delivery that nudges shoppers to add one more item.
- Guest checkout, so a first-time buyer is not forced to create an account.
- Fewer checkout fields, with sensible defaults for country and address entry.
- Cart and checkout tracking in your analytics tool.
- Abandoned cart emails that bring back people who left items behind.
- A check of the whole buying path on a real phone.

## What we do

We begin by walking through your store as a new customer, on a phone and on a computer, and writing down every place we hesitate. Then we fix those places in your PrestaShop theme and settings, working on a copy first where a change touches templates.

The Basic package focuses on a few of your best selling product pages: a clearer price and button area, delivery and returns information near the price, and trust badges. Standard widens the work to more product pages, cleans up the cart, adds a free shipping bar and sets up cart and checkout tracking. Premium adds a review of the checkout, guest checkout and field cleanup, an abandoned cart email and a plan of tests for the following month.

You receive a plain list of every change with the reason behind it, so nothing is a mystery. We do not replace your payment modules without discussing it with you first.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Start with the pages that already get the most visits.
- Show the full price, including delivery, as early as you can.
- Write returns and delivery terms in short, direct sentences.
- Check every change on your own phone.
- Give each change time to collect data before judging it.

**Avoid:**
- Adding pop-ups that cover the add to cart button.
- Forcing account creation before payment.
- Copying badges or claims that are not true for your shop.
- Changing five things at once, which hides what worked.
- Judging results after only a handful of visits.

## Who this is for

This service suits shops that get steady visitors but few orders and want to improve before buying more traffic. It suits owners who see many carts started and few finished. It also suits sellers who recently changed their theme and want to confirm the buying path still works well on mobile.

## How to get started

Tell us which products matter most and where you think shoppers get stuck. Give us staff or collaborator access to your back office and your analytics view, never your passwords. We send a short checklist, begin the review and deliver the change list when the work is done. Add-ons such as an exit intent offer, a sticky add to cart bar or product FAQ blocks can be included if they suit your range.
